description: Carlos Ruiz reaches out to Miguel Hernandez with a direct but low-pressure check-in. The RoboRide delivery partnership announcement has hit Miguel's industry harder than most visible signals in prior ticks. Carlos does not offer solutions or lecture. He contacts Miguel as a neighbor in the same disrupted world — someone who has watched the same robotaxi numbers climbing and knows what they mean for vehicle-dependent livelihoods. Carlos mentions, in passing, that he started EVT Level 2 certification a few months ago and that it has been hard to fit in after a full day at the shop but he is doing it. If Miguel asks questions, Carlos answers honestly. The message is: I see what is happening to your work, I am navigating similar pressure, and I thought it was worth saying something before things got worse.

resources_exchanged.from_carlos: time, presence, honest information about adaptation pathway
resources_exchanged.from_miguel: none required — this is a one-directional signal

expected_outcome: Trust between mechanic_carlos and car_wash_worker increases modestly. Miguel gains awareness that certification/retraining pathways exist and that someone in his network is actively pursuing one. Carlos fulfills an implicit obligation that comes with his power-over relationship. No financial exchange occurs.
